title: Borealis Foods Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Borealis Foods Inc. filed an 8-K on April 17, 2026 disclosing a Forbearance Default under its Credit Agreement with Frontwell Capital Partners Inc. The company failed to meet an April 9, 2026 milestone requiring submission of a satisfactory repayment plan. Outstanding obligations total at least $16,116,215.30. The Forbearance Period is scheduled to expire on April 27, 2026.
key_points: Borealis Foods Inc. received a Default Notice on April 13, 2026 from Frontwell Capital Partners counsel
The company failed to satisfy the April 9, 2026 milestone requiring a written repayment plan satisfactory to the Lender
Outstanding obligations under the Credit Agreement were at least $16,116,215.30 as of March 25, 2026, exclusive of accrued interest, fees, and expenses
The Forbearance Period is scheduled to expire on April 27, 2026
The Lender has not elected to terminate the Forbearance Period at this time but has reserved all rights
Borealis Foods is evaluating alternatives including potential refinancing, capital-raising, and other strategic transactions
